mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.`name`, a.arch_name AS 'archName', d.`label` AS 'state', a.create_time AS 'createTime' FROM `a_hot` a JOIN `a_hot_basic` b ON b.`hot_id` = a.`id` AND b.`del_flag` = 0 LEFT JOIN `sys_dict` d ON d.`value` = a.`state` AND d.`type` = 'hot_coop_state' AND d.`del_flag` = 0 WHERE b.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.hots_id AS 'hotsId', a.channel, a.nickname, a.country, a.contact, c2.name AS 'countrys', a.hot_level AS 'hotLevel', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT k.id) AS 'hotType', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT k.en_name) AS 'hotTypes', a.follower, a.juxing_url AS 'juxingUrl', a.url_link AS 'urlLink', a.avg_play_count AS 'avgPlayCount', a.avg_iact_rate AS 'avgIactRate', a.long_avg_views AS 'longAvgViews', a.long_iact_rate AS 'longIactRate', a.short_avg_views AS 'shortAvgViews', a.short_iact_rate AS 'shortIactRate', a.score_level AS 'scoreLevel', a.`is_match` AS 'isMatch', d1.`label` AS 'isMatchs' FROM `a_hot_basic` a LEFT JOIN `a_country` c2 ON c2.`id` = a.`country` LEFT JOIN `sys_dict` d1 ON d1.`value` = a.`is_match` AND d1.`type` = 'is_match' AND d1.`del_flag` = 0 LEFT JOIN `a_hot_type` t ON t.hotb_id = a.id LEFT JOIN `a_kol` k ON k.id = t.kol_id WHERE a.del_flag = 0 AND a.hot_id = #{hotId} GROUP BY a.id
SELECT id, hot_id AS 'hotId', hots_id AS 'hotsId' FROM `a_hot_basic` WHERE del_flag = 0 AND hots_id = #{hotsId} AND channel = #{channel} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `a_hot_basic` a JOIN `b_follower` b ON a.follower BETWEEN b.s_num AND IFNULL(b.e_num,a.follower) SET a.hot_level = b.name WHERE a.follower IS NOT NULL;
mapper.select: SELECT h.state FROM `a_hot` h JOIN `a_hot_basic` hb ON hb.hot_id = h.id WHERE hb.`id` = #{hotbId}
